name: hypercontext-mode
description: A unified context operating system for AI coding agents: sandboxed tool output, persistent memory, and reversible conversation compression in one runtime.
author: cv-superding

scripts.setup:engines: npm --prefix engines/context-mode install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix engines/billion-context install --ignore-scripts

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup:engines && npm run build:engines
